title: SparseTalk - Sparsifying 3D Gaussian Language Fields for Efficient 3D Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2609.15137v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D Gaussian language fields provide an explicit, spatially grounded representation for 3D visual question answering (VQA), but their dense semantic features can require tens of thousands of embeddings per scene, resulting in substantial storage, memory, and inference costs. We investigate how much of this representation is actually necessary for downstream reasoning. Starting from a full embedding representation, we systematically sparsify its semantic embeddings, including the previously underexplored regime below a single image-equivalent block down to 8 visual tokens. We compare random, geometric, semantic, and joint spatial-semantic selection strategies and introduce an object-based sparsification method that distributes the token budget across detected object instances while retaining background context. translated_title: SparseTalk：稀疏化3D高斯语言场以实现高效的3D视觉问答
translated_abstract: 3D高斯语言场为3D视觉问答（VQA）提供了一种显式的、空间接地的表示方式，但其密集的语义特征每个场景可能需要数万个嵌入，导致巨大的存储、内存和推理开销。我们研究了这种表示中有多少部分对下游推理任务实际上是必要的。从完整的嵌入表示出发，我们系统地对其语义嵌入进行稀疏化，包括此前未被充分探索的、低于单张图像等效块的区域，最低可降至8个视觉token。我们比较了随机、几何、语义以及联合空间-语义等选择策略，并提出了一种基于对象的稀疏化方法，该方法将token预算分配到检测到的物体实例上，同时保留背景上下文。在ScanQA和MV-ScanQA上的实验表明，密集高斯语言场中存在大量冗余。强大的VQA性能可以在……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于物体的稀疏化方法，可将3D高斯语言场的语义嵌入大幅压缩（最低至8个视觉token），证明了密集表示存在显著冗余，从而在保持强大3D视觉问答性能的同时大幅降低存储、内存和推理成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an object-based sparsification method that drastically compresses semantic embeddings in 3D Gaussian language fields (down to as few as 8 visual tokens), revealing substantial redundancy in dense representations while maintaining strong 3D VQA performance at greatly reduced storage, memory, and inference costs.
